node.title: Reference Failure Scenario and Quality-Gate Plan: Rights-Provenance Inversion — “The Author Pays for Their Own Work”
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 0. Gate-source rule and requirements boundary · 0.1 Public-provenance rule · 0.2 Core distinction under test.

relations: Authentic provenance, permission to use and contribution credit are different propositions; evidence for one should not silently decide the others.
La comparación no constituye una decisión de copyright, royalties o titularidad en un caso real.
